Class StatisticsKernel

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.core.dod.StatisticsKernel
public class StatisticsKernel extends Object

Statistics Kernel

Core operational component for the Ether civilizational and planetary simulation framework.
Integrates cellular dynamics, data structures, and deterministic state transitions.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot

  • Method Details

    • calculateGini

      public float calculateGini(float[] values)
      Computes the Gini inequality coefficient for a given resource or demographic distribution: $$G = \frac{2 \sum_{i=1}^{n} i \cdot x_i}{n \sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i} - \frac{n + 1}{n}$$ Uses an $O(m \log m)$ positive-element sparse sort when positive entries are sparse.
      Parameters:
      values - array of resource or wealth values across cells
      Returns:
      Gini coefficient bounded in $[0.0, 1.0]$

      Returns:

    • calculateLifeExpectancy

      public float calculateLifeExpectancy(float[] ages, int[] hexIds, float avgTech, float foodSatisfaction)
      Computes life expectancy at birth (Gompertz-Makeham and cliodynamic demographic model).
      Parameters:
      ages - array of cohort ages
      hexIds - array of cell indices
      avgTech - average technological index
      foodSatisfaction - nutritional satisfaction ratio in $[0, 1]$
      Returns:
      life expectancy at birth in years, bounded in $[15.0, 85.0]$
